checkpoint_policy.intermediate: frozen deterministic subset plus full route-share forward

batch_norm_semantics.label: EVAL_CURRENT_RUNNING_STATS
batch_norm_semantics.definition: checkpoint weights with BatchNorm eval mode and the running statistics stored in that checkpoint

batch_norm_semantics.label: TRAIN_ORDERED_TEST_BATCH_STATS
batch_norm_semantics.definition: a fresh checkpoint copy with BatchNorm train mode; current statistics are computed over consecutive ordered test batches of 128 (final batch 16); updated running statistics are discarded after telemetry

bn_comparison_scope: The train-mode row is a registered ordered-test co-batch diagnostic, not the literal shuffled and augmented training stream. Both rows use identical checkpoint weights and ordered inputs; neither selects checkpoints.
interpretation: For each registered BN semantic, the primary question is whether the released supervised router objective breaks the initialization collapse and creates balanced input-dependent routing. Escape timing and collapse target are reported separately by semantic. No architecture effect is preclaimed. Checkpoint selection may not use test telemetry.
